Implementation complete; pushed as Gerrit 3137 (revision ccc2b7a32639a81f69419ba336125eaae47d6ef9).

AC results (all 7 green locally):

- AC1 absence grep over src tests docs scripts (excluding tests/fixtures/ and docs/release-notes.md): no hits.
- AC2 tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_budget.py deleted.
- AC3 pytest tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py: 7 passed.
- AC4 exit 0.
- AC5 ruff check on src/rebar/llm/operations.py: clean.
- AC6 git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/release-notes.md: 21 additions, 0 deletions.
- AC7 make verify: exit 0, 19810 passed, 88 skipped, 48m59s.

Sizing evidence: a collected-node-ID diff against current main removes exactly 11 items and adds 0, every one named test_review_ticket_*. 19901 -> 19890.

src/rebar/llm/operations.py goes 218 -> 103 LOC. assemble_context, _format_ticket, and the select_reviewers re-export survive; _review_ticket_impl, default_reviewer_id, and _REVIEW_MIN_STEPS are gone along with five now-unused imports.

One unplanned in-scope correction: assemble_context's own docstring named the single-pass engine as a consumer. Left alone it would be a stale claim about a symbol this change deletes, so it was corrected and reflowed to clear E501.

Rebased onto fbe9c6f360a before the first push. That commit touches only fsck_tracker_health.py and test_fsck_push_pending.py, disjoint from this change's 8 files, so the verify result stands.
